name: StrokeCap
brief: Enumeration determining the ending type of a stroke in the open sub-paths.

members.name: Butt
members.brief: The stroke ends exactly at each of the two end-points of a sub-path. For zero length sub-paths no stroke is rendered.

members.name: Round
members.brief: The stroke is extended in both end-points of a sub-path by a half circle, with a radius equal to the half of a stroke width. For zero length sub-paths a full circle is rendered.

members.name: Square
members.brief: The stroke is extended in both end-points of a sub-path by a rectangle, with the width equal to the stroke width and the length equal to the half of the stroke width. For zero length sub-paths the square is rendered with the size of the stroke width.
